caption:
Free time never comes. You make it. 🎹

Same dream, two plans. One plays piano 10 minutes a day. One waits for free time. Day 30, wrong note again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 3 songs by heart vs 365 "maybe tomorrows".

Listen to the song come together.

Send this to someone waiting for free time.

#piano #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
